rendered:
1. Aging (activation of the superelastic/shape-memory NiTi wire, before any coating): the wires were heat-treated at process at 600 °C for 1 h under vacuum[1] in a quartz CVD tube furnace.
2. Atomic layer deposition of the vanadium oxide coating ran at a reaction temperature of 200 °C[2], maintained throughout the process. This is the deposition temperature rather than a separate heat-treatment step.
3. Post-deposition annealing (to crystallize the coating into V2O5): the deposited films were annealed at 450 °C for 30 min[3] in a quartz CVD tube furnace open to air.
